notes.title: Level Music Now Added
notes.content:
[h1]Level Music Added[/h1]

The game now has Level Music ;-)
If you find it too irritating you can adjust the music volume in the Options Menu.

Thanks
Paul

notes.title: Title Music Added
notes.content:
[h1]Title Music Added[/h1]

The game now has Title Music
I'll be adding music to the levels very soon ;-)

Please remember I am just a solo developer updating the game when I can to keep improving it

If you like the game please help me by leaving a nice review

Thanks
Paul

notes.title: Personal Best Score displays for level completions
notes.content:
When completing a level you will now see your personal best score for the level as well as your personal best rank on the level.

Enjoy
Paul

notes.title: Level High Scores Now Visible
notes.content:
On completion of a level you will now see the 5 best high scores for that level.
You will also see the score you've just got for the level so you can compare your performance.

This will be updated later to also show your "Personal Best" for the level.

Enjoy and please leave a review for the game to help with the promotion.

notes.title: Level High Score Recording (Upcoming Leaderboards)
notes.content:
End of level scores will now be registered for each level on Steam Leaderboards.
These level specific high scores will soon be visible in game.

Happy Blasting
Paul
